title: CNBC Interview: Path Is Clear, Question Is Pace
summary: In a CNBC interview (press coverage only, via a short Valor piece with quotes translated to Portuguese), Barkin repeats that with unemployment near historic lows and inflation too high the path forward is 'pretty clear' (further hikes) and the only question is pace, which he still sees as appropriately gradual given global uncertainty and incoming information. He adds an explicit stance read that was not in the Oct. 30 SiriusXM remarks: policy is close to neutral, neither restraining nor stimulating growth, which strengthens the case that more tightening is needed. Inflation is 'the most important risk right now', and he hopes the September hike and any further action will bear on it; AI is a near-term source of price pressure even if it should boost supply and ease inflation over time. The message is essentially unchanged from Oct. 30: more hikes as the base case, at a gradual pace.

key_quotes.quote: O desemprego está próximo de mínimas históricas, e a inflação está alta demais. Isso significa que o caminho a seguir é bastante claro. A questão, naturalmente, é o ritmo
key_quotes.context: Further hikes are the base case; pace is the open question (Valor translation of the CNBC interview).

key_quotes.quote: Um ritmo gradual faz sentido se considerarmos a incerteza existente no cenário global e o fato de que novas informações surgirão ao longo do período.
key_quotes.context: Gradualism justified by uncertainty, not by doubts about direction.

key_quotes.quote: é o risco mais importante no momento, e espero que nossa medida em setembro, bem como qualquer outra ação que venhamos a adotar no futuro, tenha algum impacto sobre a inflação
